tasks.title: Add the meta feature and module wiring
tasks.description: Add meta = [] to Cargo.toml as an additive default-off feature and declare pub mod meta behind cfg(feature = meta).

tasks.title: Define MetaClient and typed requests
tasks.description: MetaClient with Secret credentials and base-URL validation, plus SendMessageRequest, MessageAttachment, and WhatsAppTemplate.

tasks.title: Messenger text and media send
tasks.description: FacebookMessenger::send_text and send_media posting to /{page-id}/messages with messaging_type and recipient.id.

tasks.title: Instagram DM send
tasks.description: InstagramDm reusing SendMessageRequest against the Instagram Graph host.

tasks.title: WhatsApp text and template send
tasks.description: WhatsAppBusiness::send_text and send_template with ordered parameters and a local parameter-count check.

tasks.title: WhatsApp media upload
tasks.description: upload_media returning an attachment id usable by a subsequent send.

tasks.title: Signature verification and parsing
tasks.description: HMAC-SHA256 over raw bytes with constant-time comparison, fail closed, and a size-bounded body.

tasks.title: Subscription handshake
tasks.description: Echo hub.challenge when hub.mode=subscribe and hub.verify_token matches, reject otherwise, and provide subscribe/unsubscribe calls.

tasks.title: Normalise inbound events
tasks.description: Map Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp payloads into MetaEvent with surface, dedupe key, and an unsupported variant.

tasks.title: Map nested Graph errors
tasks.description: Flatten error.message, error.code, error.error_subcode, and error.fbtrace_id into WirekitError::Api.

tasks.title: Surface usage and integrate backoff
tasks.description: Parse X-Business-Use-Case-Usage, expose it on the response type, and let the existing retry policy back off on 429 and 5xx.

tasks.title: Redact credentials
tasks.description: Hand-written Debug for MetaClient and its config so neither token nor app secret renders.

tasks.title: Enforce HTTPS and token scope
tasks.description: Reject cleartext base URLs at construction and reject a caller identity that contradicts the configured page or phone number.

tasks.title: Document the module
tasks.description: Module-level docs with scope and non-goals, rustdoc on every public item, README provider row and example, and a CHANGELOG entry.

tasks.title: Run formatter, linter, docs, and governance checks
tasks.description: cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings, RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps, node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js.
